correctness.rationale: For every N>=3 and p>=1 the multiplicity-free symmetric-square and conjugate-square Dynkin lists and harmonic-tensor product are explicitly derived; intersections were checked algebraically by rank and verified by exact checker for finite samples. Character orthogonality yields rank-specific identities including all cross-phase coefficients. Triangle and balancing inequalities are attained simultaneously. The rank-three derivative is a cubic with monotone positive branch, guaranteeing unique positive global optimum; equality congruences classify all complex phases. At N>=4 monotone coefficient-energy inequalities give full equality. The standalone checker ran 984 exact symbolic and Weyl-grid assertions and the infinite cases rest on the analytical proof.

value.rationale: The natural rank-dependent sharp L4 norm of one symmetric-power central Fourier mode, its contragredient, and the trivial mode has a nontrivial transition: rank three forces three-mode mixing while higher ranks exclude the constant, with arithmetic changes in phase rigidity. Exact sharp all-weight constants, a unique algebraic parameter, full extremizers and perturbative high-weight gain provide structural information unavailable from generic orthogonality or coarse single-character bounds.
